products.description:
Intel Core Ultra 9 285K Gaming PC

The Intel Core Ultra 9 285K Gaming PC is a powerhouse built for gamers, streamers, and creators who demand cutting-edge performance and immersive experiences. At its heart, this system features the Intel Core Ultra 9 285K Arrow Lake processor, delivering exceptional speed, efficiency, and multitasking capabilities. Paired with the ASUS ROG MAXIMUS Z890 HERO BTF ATX motherboard, the Intel Core Ultra 9 285K Gaming PC ensures rock-solid stability, advanced overclocking support, and premium connectivity for next-level computing. Memory comes in the form of 128GB Kingston FURY Beast DDR5 RAM, operating at an ultra-fast 6000MHz with low CL30 latency and RGB lighting, ensuring lightning responsiveness whether gaming at ultra-settings, editing videos, or handling AI workloads. For storage, the Team T-FORCE GE PRO 2TB PCIe Gen 5 NVMe SSD with AirFlow I heatsink delivers blazing speeds, making boot-ups and data transfers almost instantaneous. To keep the Intel Core Ultra 9 285K Gaming PC cool under intense loads, the Asus ROG STRIX LC III 360 ARGB liquid cooler provides superior thermal management with a sleek design. Graphics power comes from the ASUS ROG Astral GeForce RTX 5090 OC Edition, equipped with a massive 32GB of GDDR7 memory, ensuring unmatched performance for 4K and even 8K gaming, ray tracing, and AI-enhanced rendering. The ASUS TUF Gaming 1200G power supply provides 1200W of stable, efficient power delivery, ensuring long-term reliability with its 80 Plus Gold certification. Housed in the Asus ROG Hyperion GR701 BTF Edition ARGB mid-tower case, this Intel Gaming PC not only performs at the highest level but also impresses with a premium aesthetic design and ARGB lighting. For visuals, the Asus ROG Strix XG27ACG 27-inch Fast IPS monitor with 180Hz refresh rate and WQHD resolution delivers smooth, vibrant gameplay. Together, these components create the ultimate Intel Core Desktop PC, offering unmatched speed, durability, and immersive visuals. Designed for serious gamers and professionals, the Intel Core Ultra 9 285K Gaming PC sets a new standard for performance and future-ready technology.
